title: aatini turha sharrahni
description: Arabic hard techno with an acid groove, brief female spoken hooks, rolling sub bass, evolving 303 synths, metallic percussion, and explosive club drops.

title: acid explosion
description: Acid techno and acid house instrumental with a 909 kick, rolling bass, screaming TB-303 patterns, industrial percussion, and peak-time rave drops.

title: baroque voltage
description: Modern peak-time melodic techno with cascading Baroque violin motifs, string orchestra, harpsichord accents, rolling bass, and powerful cinematic drops.

title: desert frequency
description: Peak-time psychedelic techno and psytrance with Israeli desert-rave energy, rolling bass, darbuka, qanun and ney motifs, acid 303s, and euphoric drops.

title: desert tribes
description: Levantine tribal techno with Hijaz and Bayati colors, mijwiz, oud, rababa, darbuka and dabke percussion, deep bass, and three festival-scale drops.

title: eternal dreams
description: Uplifting dream trance with emotional piano, shimmering arpeggios, ethereal pads, rolling bass, soaring supersaws, and euphoric melodic drops.

title: gates of eternity
description: Extended progressive and uplifting trance with desert plucks, rolling bass, cinematic strings, euphoric supersaws, acid-trance transitions, and four major drops.

title: girls, boys, everybody
description: Euphoric desert festival house with tribal bass, darbuka, acid arpeggios, spoken Girls/Boys/Everybody call-and-response, rising builds, and explosive drops.

title: total chaos
description: Explosive Israeli full-on psytrance with bouncy FM and acid leads, rolling bass, evolving rhythmic hooks, dramatic risers, and a huge festival drop.

title: welcome to israel
description: Dark industrial and acid techno with deep robotic male announcements, distorted kick, rumbling bass, metallic percussion, and warehouse-rave energy.

title: winter storm
description: Peak-time 140 BPM techno inspired by winter Baroque strings, with virtuoso violin, icy tremolo, heavy kick, rolling bass, acid accents, and three explosive drops.
